basic_details.short_information: VMMC Safdarjung Recruitment 2026 OUT! Vardhman Mahavir Medical College Safdarjung Hospital (VMMC Safdarjung) has released 34 vacancies for Assistant Administrative Officer, Administrative Officer, and Senior Administrative Officer posts on a deputation basis under Advt. No. ADMN-15/154/2026-ADMN-I. Interested and eligible candidates can download the application form from the official website vmmc-sih.mohfw.gov.in and submit it through offline mode. The application process is open, and candidates must ensure that their applications reach the prescribed address on or before 21st August 2026. Rea

qualification.details: Assistant Administrative Officer: Officers of the Central Government holding analogous posts or with 5 years service in Level-6 and possessing experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters. Administrative Officer: Officers under Central/State Governments holding analogous posts or with 2 years service in Level-7 and possessing Degree from recognised University and 2 years experience in Administration/Establishment work. Senior Administrative Officer: Officers of Central/State Government holding analogous posts or with 2 years service in Level-9 or Level-8 and possessing Bachelors Degree and 3 years experience as Administrative Officer.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Administrative Officer: Officers of the Central Government holding analogous posts or with 5 years service in Level-6 and possessing experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters. Administrative Officer: Officers under Central/State Governments holding analogous posts or with 2 years service in Level-7 and possessing Degree from recognised University and 2 years experience in Administration/Establishment work. Senior Administrative Officer: Officers of Central/State Government holding analogous posts or with 2 years service in Level-9 or Level-8 and possessing Bachelors Degree and 3 years experience as Administrative Officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for VMMC Safdarjung Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://vmmc-sih.mohfw.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VMMC Safdarjung Administrative Officers posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the VMMC Safdarjung Administrative Officers posts is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Administrative Officers at VMMC Safdarjung?
faq.answer: There are a total of 34 vacancies for Administrative Officers posts at Vardhman Mahavir Medical College Safdarjung Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Administrative Officers posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Administrative Officers posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for VMMC Safdarjung Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited Administrative Officers?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Level-7 to Level-10 as per the 7th CPC, with specific pay scales for each post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Assistant Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: For Assistant Administrative Officer, candidates should be Central Government officers holding analogous posts or with 5 years of service in Level-6 and experience in administration, establishment, and accounts matters.

faq.answer: The selection process includes application through the proper channel, document verification, and final selection by the Competent Authority.
